name: @opsgrids/visual
description: The visual and accessibility regression harness: Playwright screenshots and axe over every opsgrids-ui story and a set of real app pages rendered against contract-shaped API mocks.

scripts.visual:targets: pnpm --filter @opsgrids/ui run build-storybook && pnpm --filter @opsgrids/opsgrids-dashboard --filter @opsgrids/product-crm --filter @opsgrids/opsgrids-internal exec vite build --logLevel warn
scripts.visual:update: pnpm run visual:targets && VISUAL_UPDATE=1 playwright test --update-snapshots=changed
